# Double Diffusion

> A Los Angeles-based production studio providing AI/VFX solutions for
> professional productions: hybrid AI/VFX workflows with customizable models,
> plus full post-production support for ads, narratives, and music videos.

Production partnerships: creative@doublediffusion.co
General inquiries & press: manager@doublediffusion.co
Based in Los Angeles and Houston.

## AI/Hybrid Solutions

- [Solutions overview](https://www.doublediffusion.co/#services): Pre-production, on-set production, and post-production AI/VFX support, plus pure AI production.

## Work

- [All work](https://www.doublediffusion.co/work): Portfolio, filterable by Pure AI and Hybrid.
- [Example Work Case](https://www.doublediffusion.co/work/example-work-case): A professional commercial project, from pre-production through post-production.
- [Pure AI Reel](https://www.doublediffusion.co/work/pure-ai-reel): Fully generated work for productions with little to no acting.
